name: RectangleTest
summary: This EA identifies rectangular price consolidation ranges (rectangle patterns) on the chart and trades breakouts from those ranges. It automatically draws rectangle zones based on price action and enters positions when price breaks above or below the established boundaries.
summary_zh: 该EA识别图表上的矩形价格整理区间(矩形形态),并在价格突破这些区间时进行交易。它根据价格行为自动绘制矩形区域,并在价格突破已建立的边界时开仓。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于矩形整理形态的突破交易,即在价格在一个水平区间内横盘整理后,等待价格突破区间上轨或下轨时入场。入场条件为价格收盘突破矩形上边界时做多,突破矩形下边界时做空,突破确认后顺势入场。出场条件通常包括设置止损在矩形对侧边界附近,止盈则根据矩形高度的一倍或数倍来设定,也可能使用追踪止损。仓位管理方面,根据矩形区间的宽度来衡量突破后的目标幅度,较宽的矩形意味着更大的突破潜力。资金管理通常采用固定手数或基于账户风险的百分比来计算仓位大小。该策略的核心优势在于矩形形态是市场整理后选择方向的重要信号,突破后的动量往往较强。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on breakout trading from rectangular consolidation patterns, where price trades sideways within a horizontal range before breaking out. Entry conditions are triggered when price closes above the upper boundary of the rectangle for a long position, or below the lower boundary for a short position, entering in the direction of the breakout. Exit conditions typically include setting a stop loss near the opposite boundary of the rectangle, while take profit is calculated based on one or more times the height of the rectangle pattern, and trailing stops may also be employed. Position sizing takes into account the width of the rectangular range to measure the breakout target amplitude, as wider rectangles imply greater breakout potential. Money management typically uses fixed lot sizes or calculates position size based on a percentage of account risk. The core advantage of this strategy is that rectangle patterns are significant signals of market direction after consolidation, and breakouts often carry strong momentum.

pros: 矩形突破是经典的图表形态策略,逻辑清晰且易于理解
止损位置明确,可设置在矩形对侧边界,风险可控
突破交易顺应市场动量方向,胜率在有过滤条件时较高
策略自动化消除了主观判断,执行纪律性强
pros_en: Rectangle breakout is a classic chart pattern strategy with clear and understandable logic
Stop loss placement is well-defined at the opposite boundary of the rectangle, making risk manageable
Breakout trading follows market momentum direction, with decent win rates when proper filters are applied
Strategy automation eliminates subjective judgment and ensures disciplined execution
cons: 假突破风险较高,价格可能短暂突破后回落造成止损
矩形形态的自动识别可能不够准确,存在误判风险
缺乏对市场整体趋势的过滤,可能在震荡市中频繁触发假信号
固定手数交易未考虑账户风险动态调整,资金管理不够灵活
cons_en: High risk of false breakouts where price briefly breaks the range then reverses, triggering stop losses
Automatic rectangle pattern recognition may lack accuracy and carry misidentification risk
Lacks an overall market trend filter, which may lead to frequent false signals in choppy markets
Fixed lot sizing does not dynamically adjust based on account risk, making money management inflexible
improvements: 增加成交量确认过滤,要求突破时成交量放大以减少假突破
添加更高时间周期趋势过滤,仅在顺大势方向突破时入场
实现基于账户风险的动态仓位计算,替代固定手数
improvements_en: Add volume confirmation filter requiring increased volume on breakout to reduce false breakouts
Add higher timeframe trend filter to only enter breakouts in the direction of the broader trend
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account risk instead of fixed lot sizes

risk_points: 假突破可能导致连续止损,在区间震荡市场中频繁亏损
若未设置止损或止损过宽,单笔交易可能承受较大亏损
risk_points_en: False breakouts may lead to consecutive stop losses and frequent losses in range-bound markets
If stop loss is not set or is too wide, a single trade may incur significant loss
